notes: Gen 75 + Web 402 — GEN75-FACE-SPLIT-NOV10 (owner, Nov 10, 2026, 09:24 recording, minutes after a cache clear + force stop + relaunch; his order: 'fix this time discrepancy between the app itself and the picture in picture and widget'): the app card read Working 00:54:32 with 2.3 km while the glance read 00:50:02 (270 s behind) and the faces showed TWO km figures (0.5 on one, 2.3 on another). CONVICTED by the new suite tools/session-relaunch-v94-test.js (shipped law fails R1/R2/R4/R6, fixed law all-pass; the timer/bubble/widget family at its standings): (1) the record's miles had NO convergence door — the snapshot the page reconciles from does not carry the record's miles, the v325 clock adoption deliberately never re-syncs, and syncs outside transitions are rare in a dark window, so the record kept an early 0.5 km LiveMiles checkpoint under the page's true 2.3 km indefinitely; and any lifetime's KNOWN-but-stale total landed whole, flipping the native faces DOWN to a checkpoint (R2). (2) The clock convergence step stood down whenever the LOADS branch moved on the same collect pass, and when that pass's consume sync was the one that hung (a boot sync whose promise never settles), nothing ever re-ran it — the record's native re-anchor (a real 270 s pause fold, signals dropped by design in the dark window) stood against the page's pin clock for the whole foreground session (R4, the film's exact numbers). (3) Reconciliation was lifecycle-bound, never cadence-bound: a face tap whose live signal could not be delivered (the listenerless window after a relaunch) was dropped under the 'reconciled, not replayed' rule, with no standing collect to reconcile it (R6). THE FIX: (web, js/app.js only) the convergence gate counts only a STATUS adoption as 'changed' — a loads change no longer suppresses the clock step; after a v325 clock adoption the page lands its facts into the record with one sync on the adopted pair (the miles cross in the same pass; the pair is the record's own so no arbitration can move the clock); and the tracker tick collects the record on a 15 s cadence while a session is live and the page is visible, so any missed window converges in seconds. (native gen 75, vc69/1.67) SessionRecord.syncFromWeb: same-session miles are monotonic — a sync naming the record's own session family may move the day total forward, never back (a different session's total is untouched; R5 keeps the new-session reset and the unknown-miles guard). ShiftTrackPlugin.signalPipAction: an undeliverable signal is stashed into pendingPipAction — the store the page already drains at init / visibility / PiP-exit — instead of dropped. The miles-truth halves landed separately (web 399 cloud persistence, web 401 trail reconcile); this ship is the record/face half. IN-HANDS VERDICT OWED: after any relaunch, and after any bubble/widget pause-resume, the app, the widget and the PiP all read ONE elapsed and ONE km figure within seconds of opening the app.
